body:
Hi Sara!
 
We're in the process of wrapping up our study, and I have some questions about our exported data. Specifically, we set the surveys to be sent at 9, noon, 3pm, 6pm, and 9pm everyday. However, some of our observations say that the surveys were sent at odd times - for example 3:30pm, or midnight. Do you know why that might be the case?
 
Thanks!
Jane
FYI. Split it from the Sales group. They conduct multiple studies. Here are the study IDs for your reference: 3999, 4000, 3984, 3985, and 3020.

subject: Discrepancies in the times surveys were sent out
body:
Hi Jane,
This is Amin from Avicenna tech team.
Regarding your issue can you please provide more details?
(If it's possible you can also add me to your study. This way you only need to answer my second question. My email address is amin.ghaffari@avicennaresearch.com)

- What is your study ID?
- How many participants are affected by this issue and if possible, their IDs?
- Affected participants' timezone and your timezone. At times it might be caused by a difference in the timezone.
- An image of your trigerring logic
- An image of the Activity Session tab from the sidebar to make sure that the activities are created properly

Best regards,
Amin

Note: If you feel like your issue is not properly being addressed and want to escalate it, please click here: https://avicennaresearch.com/app/public/zammad/escalate/25528/d302e9af871558f4
